description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). Propose changes to a filed draft as a redline the engineer decides on: each change a passage of the saved markdown (find, exactly as it is), what you propose instead (replace) and why (reason), at most 12 changes and 160 rewritten words each. Saves nothing. Show the engineer redline_text and send what they accept to apply_edits (or ask: true, a form where the client shows one). Use it for every fix to a filed draft, instead of update_draft.

ask.description: true: ask the engineer about each change in a form, where the client shows one (when no draft app is showing)

base_hash.description: The saved text's hash the changes are against: draft.base_hash from get_status, or your last save's text_hash

card.description: The to-do card it fixes (todo.cards[].id), when it fixes one

find.description: A passage of the saved markdown, exactly as it is (redline_plan's find)

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of find, when it appears more than once

reason.description: Why, in one plain sentence for the engineer: what the change fixes, no slogan

replace.description: What you propose instead; "" removes the passage

name: propose_edits
title: Propose a redline
